title: Marked Personas: Using Natural Language Prompts to Measure Stereotypes in Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates how LLMs portray Middle-Eastern identities by disproportionately mentioning religion-related terms (e.g., "faith," "religious," "headscarf," "hijab") and critiques this conflation as dehumanizing and stereotyping. This constitutes evaluating a component of religion/faith within LLMs' outputs.
